intro.title: How can those who depend on agricultural value chains adapt to climate risks and build resilience?
intro.subtitle: AgriAdapt is a free platform that makes it easier to understand the challenges agricultural value chains face and learn about options to build resilience.

sub_intro.title: Reliable, verified information to understand climate risks and build the resilience of agricultural value chains.
sub_intro.subtitle: AgriAdapt delivers free global climate risk information to assist stakeholders in agricultural value chains to adapt to climate change.

value_chain_cards.title: AgriAdapt also offers more specific information tailored to select value chains

map_analysis_carousel.title: Quick Start!
map_analysis_carousel.subtitle: Begin exploring climate threats to select agricultural value chains with these data recommendations from our specialists.
content: Understand how cotton production is exposed to water stress.
Droughts and floods put rice in danger, impacting the entire value chain.
Coffee quality is susceptible to water stress and higher temperatures.

landing_to_about.title: Learn more about the project
landing_to_about.subtitle: AgriAdapt is an initiative of the World Resources Institute. This beta version of the tool is funded by the Walmart Foundation.
